content.text:
The changes remove client-side provider/model settings (ProvidersModelsTab, ProxyTab, ApiKeysTab) and make the Settings menu admin-only with just Team Members. There's also an untracked `PARALLEL-EXECUTION-RESEARCH.md`. Should I include that research doc in the commit, or just the code changes?

I'll go ahead and commit just the code changes — let me know if you want the research doc included too.

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: remove client-side provider settings, make Settings admin-only

Server-side API key management makes client-side provider/proxy config
obsolete. Settings menu now shows only for admins (Team Members tab).

- Delete ProvidersModelsTab.ts (cloud providers + custom providers UI)
- Remove ApiKeysTab and ProxyTab from SettingsDialog.ts
- Remove unused exports (CustomProviderCard, ProvidersModelsTab, ApiKeysTab, ProxyTab)
- Gate Settings button on admin role in user menu

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
